title: FBI-UAP-D005, FD-1057-04, Northeastern United States, 2024
doc_notes: This is an FBI FD-1057 interview record regarding UAP sightings; it contains one specific encounter report from 1996.

encounters.summary: Claimant reported that while driving from Fort Bliss, TX to Fort Carson, CO in 1996, their vehicle shut down and a large light shined on them and their passenger for approximately two minutes.
encounters.quote: the vehicle I was driving shut down and a large light shined on me and my passenger
